LanguageData.pas_empire_war_VassalOutpostsTip: When on, your Empire vassal settlements spawn their own satellite outposts (using NPC Outposts).
LanguageData.pas_empire_war_TransferOnConquestTip: When you capture an NPC settlement its outposts join your empire; when a vassal falls its outposts go to the conqueror.
LanguageData.pas_empire_war_OutpostsSeizedText: {0} satellite outpost(s) defected to your empire when you captured {1}.
LanguageData.pas_empire_war_OutpostsLostText: {0} satellite outpost(s) were handed to {1} when your vassal fell.
